{{Quote|The Deftoi of Muntro VI in the Outer Rim are staging their decennial Otherworld Arts Festival. A new composition in their quasi-operatic ceremonial artform, which their formal request translates roughly as "highmind stagecraft," dramatizes a bloody period in Naboo's history before the Great Time of Peace.|An announcement from the Office of the [[Music Advisor/Legends|Music Advisor]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]|<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Arts Festival Requires Naboo Animals}} on Naboo</ref>}}
The '''Otherworld Arts Festival''' was a decennial arts festival held by the [[Deftoi]] of [[Muntro VI]].<ref name="SWG" /> The [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> edition of the Otherworld Arts Festival included a quasi-operatic performance depicting the events of the [[Time of Suffering/Legends|Time of Suffering]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. For this purpose, the Deftoi requested the Office of the [[Music Advisor/Legends|Music Advisor]] of Naboo to provide carcasses of Naboo animals for the show.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Otherworld Arts Festival was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
